mapper.sql: SELECT s.stock_id, s.part_id, s.warehouse_name, s.storage_location, s.current_stock, s.lock_qty, p.stock_min, p.stock_max, s.safety_stock, s.version, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, COALESCE(s.update_time, s.create_time) as update_time, s.remark, p.part_code, p.part_name, p.part_type, p.spec_model, p.unit, p.supplier, p.status as part_status FROM dms_spare_part_stock s LEFT JOIN dms_spare_part p ON s.part_id = p.part_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.part_id = #{partId} AND s.warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_spare_part_stock SET current_stock = current_stock + #{delta}, version = version + 1 WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.delete: UPDATE dms_spare_part_stock SET del_flag = '2' WHERE stock_id IN #{stockId}
mapper.select: WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND ( (p.stock_min > 0 AND s.current_stock <= p.stock_min) OR (p.stock_max > 0 AND s.current_stock >= p.stock_max) ) AND p.part_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partCode}, '%') AND p.part_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partName}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.current_stock <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN p.stock_min > 0 AND s.current_stock <= p.stock_min THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.current_stock ASC
